item: The Wikipedia walk and WARM pause name settings that could not be read, instead of 'Protected mode has no usable proxy' (follows R766 and row 250)
summary: lane_service_status marks a walk or WARM pause for transport_unavailable with stored: unreadable while the safety settings cannot be read (transport_summary's mark from row 250); the Living sources overview passes it on and the view and the task manager's walk row then say the settings could not be read. What waits, and that it never goes direct, is unchanged. 2 strings x12. Release line: When the app's settings cannot be read, the Wikipedia page walk and the changed-pages tier now say so when they wait, instead of saying protected mode has no usable proxy.
